data.rationale: Scenario-owned durable data observed in the canonical data directory.

budget.rationale: Durable data storage budget measured and governed on 2026-08-05; the byte ceiling prevents unbounded growth without permitting automatic deletion.

storage.rationale: Storage surfaces are declared from observed canonical scenario directories; external resource databases are not claimed by this scenario.

service.name: code-facts
service.description: Target-aware code evidence service for Vrooli scenarios and generic code roots

architecture-cartographer.description: Code-facts can query Architecture Cartographer for file-domain facts when a target needs domain partitioning beyond local source discovery.
architecture-cartographer.degraded_behavior: File-domain facts fall back to local source and import evidence when Architecture Cartographer is unavailable.

search-hub.description: Code-facts registers its code and contract search leaves with Search Hub when the local gateway is available.
search-hub.degraded_behavior: Code Facts remains queryable directly when Search Hub is unavailable; registration retries on the next lifecycle start.

go-code-graph.description: Code-facts uses Go Code Graph as the analyzer backend for Go source graph extraction.
go-code-graph.degraded_behavior: Go graph fact families are unavailable for targets that require Go analyzer execution.

typescript-code-graph.description: Code-facts uses TypeScript Code Graph as the analyzer backend for TypeScript source graph extraction.
typescript-code-graph.degraded_behavior: TypeScript graph fact families are unavailable for targets that require TypeScript analyzer execution.
